resources.string: Tap the accessibility button, double-tap the back of your phone (Quick Tap), or double-press Volume Down in any app to make the text on screen selectable.\n\nLasso reads the text shown on screen, takes a screenshot to recognize text in it, and listens for volume key presses, only to make that text selectable when you ask for it. Everything is processed on the phone. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere: the app has no internet access.
